title: Đã xong chưa: completion questions with chưa

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say how much —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bao nhiêu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say one —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: một] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say two —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say three —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ba] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say four —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bốn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say five —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: năm] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Anh ăn chưa?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, ăn rồi.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Đói không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, không đói.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today's structure: asking if something is done. Add] [VI: chưa] [EN: to the end of a sentence — it means yet, or not yet. Answer] [VI: rồi] [EN: already, or] [VI: chưa] [EN: not yet.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: ăn] [EN: means to eat. It has] [VI: ngang] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: ăn] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: ăn] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ăn] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: rồi] [EN: means already. It has] [VI: dấu huyền] [EN: — falling. Listen again.] [VI_F: rồi] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: rồi] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rồi] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: chưa] [EN: means not yet, or, at the end of a question, yet. It has] [VI: ngang] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: chưa] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: chưa] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chưa] [EN: Good. Ask it.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: ăn chưa] [EN: have you eaten yet?] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: ăn rồi] [EN: already ate.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To eat —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ăn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Already —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rồi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Not yet, or yet —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chưa] [EN: Good.]
